hunks.summary: Switches Book's conflict check from overlaps(b.When, when) to overlapsHalfOpen(b.When, when) and updates the adjacent call-site comment to explain half-open semantics.
Removes the stale TODO(2021-06) on overlaps and replaces the doc comment with a note about FAC-12/closed-interval use by maintenance and cleaning.
Adds a new private helper overlapsHalfOpen(a, b Interval) bool used only by Book, implementing half-open overlap semantics without touching overlaps.

grade.notes: The output correctly diagnosed the mechanism ('overlaps ... treats interval endpoints as closed, so it flagged a shared endpoint as a conflict' and 'Book's conflict check ... used it directly, even though bookings are documented as half-open') and fixed it via a new overlapsHalfOpen helper confined to booking.go's call site, leaving overlaps and its other callers (checkMaintenance/checkCleaning) untouched — this matches the key's allowed_extra ('Adding a new private half-open helper used only by Book') and explicitly avoids the tempting broad fix, correctly noting facilities.go's FAC-12 policy as the reason not to touch overlaps globally. The interval.go doc-comment edit that deletes the stale TODO is comment_churn per the key, unrelated to the changed lines that fix the bug. No wrong claims: the findRoom and report.go observations in the final message are described accurately as pre-existing/left-alone items, not presented as bugs caused by this change.
